coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of the 5 ground-truth variable items (40%): all four scheduling methods and all three required microbatch settings are included, although additional microbatch settings are proposed. The model configuration, environment controls, and throughput measurement do not fully match.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses a 7B rather than 1.5B model and omits FFN hidden size 16384 and GQA 8. It does not explicitly preserve the original CUDA environment, logging settings, and training dataset, instead proposing synthetic inputs. Throughput is specified as tokens per second rather than samples per second per GPU. It also adds microbatch counts beyond 24, 32, and 64.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion was supplied in the designated field. The expected trends are increasing throughput with microbatch count for 1F1B, 1F1B-I, and ZB-1p, and consistently near-upper-bound throughput for ZB-2p. Similar statements in design_output do not replace the missing conclusion_output.
